check.text: RECORD COMPLETE: 67 CHOICES, 6 FIGHTS REPLAYED AND MATCHED

event.name: The Master Smith
event.text: The smith is drunk, cheerful and working for free. "Give it here. I'll make it sing."

options.label: LET HIM TRY
options.text: A piece of yours becomes one of the next rarity, of its kind (a rare one a legendary). Half the time it cracks and is lost.

notes: The Master Smith: let him try.
The Dagger cracked in the forge and is lost.
Took a tome: the Hoplite learns Aspis.

event.name: Ambush!
event.text: The road narrows between two rocks. Something is waiting up there.

options.label: FIGHT
options.text: A hard fight, with an elite's spoils.

notes: the Frostweaver joins at the fire.

event.name: An Empty Camp
event.text: Someone left in a hurry: the fire is still burning, the bedrolls still laid out.

options.label: MAKE CAMP
options.text: A campfire: rest, focus, raise or train.

options.label: SEARCH THE PACKS
options.text: A potion, a tonic or a phoenix feather, and 20 gold.

notes: The stranger teaches, and moves on.
Hoplite's Paired guard: Line of shields.
